headword: {南無阿弥陀仏|なむあみだぶつ}

definitions.gloss: Namu Amida Butsu; the nenbutsu invocation
definitions.explanation: "I take refuge in Amida Buddha": the phrase recited in Pure Land Buddhism, believed to bring rebirth in Amida's Pure Land. Also said at funerals and graves, and when praying for the dead.

examples.english: Every morning my grandmother puts her hands together before the family altar and says Namu Amida Butsu.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浄土宗|じょうどしゅう}→浄土宗：31849_joudoshuu⟧や⟦{浄土真宗|じょうどしんしゅう}→浄土真宗：33241_joudoshinshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{南無阿弥陀仏|なむあみだぶつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{唱|とな}えれば→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{極楽|ごくらく}→極楽：21229_gokuraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{往生|おうじょう}→往生：12704_oujou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{説|と}く→説く：14245_toku⟧。

notes:
{南無|なむ} (from Sanskrit namas, "homage, I take refuge") + ⟦{阿弥陀仏|あみだぶつ}→阿弥陀仏：25098_amidabutsu⟧ (Amida Buddha). Reciting it is the ⟦{念仏|ねんぶつ}→念仏：12850_nenbutsu⟧ of the Pure Land schools.

- {南無阿弥陀仏|なむあみだぶつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to recite the nenbutsu
